title: Handle allOf composition in OpenAPI schemas
description: Flatten allOf members into a single merged Complex type by combining properties from all member schemas. This is the most common composition pattern in OpenAPI for inheritance/mixins. Tests: merge two objects via allOf, allOf with a $ref and inline properties, deeply nested allOf, allOf with conflicting property names.
notes: Recommended model: Opus 4.6 — Most complex piece, merging schemas across refs + inline properties, deeply nested cases, edge cases
close_reason: Implemented allOf composition: merges properties from all member schemas, handles $ref + inline, deeply nested allOf, conflicting names (first wins), allOf in property position, and sibling properties.

title: Handle special primitive definitions in OpenAPI compiler
description: Some K8s definitions are bare types that get $ref'd, not objects: type: string (Quantity, RawExtension), type: string format: date-time (Time, MicroTime), type: string format: int-or-string (IntOrString), no type at all / polymorphic (JSON, JSONSchemaPropsOrArray, etc.). These should resolve to scalar Shale types at the $ref site, not generate Mapper subclasses. The existing find_or_compile_ref_target already handles this for simple cases but may need adjustment for edge cases like missing type.
close_reason: Existing code already handles all K8s primitive definition patterns correctly. Added comprehensive test covering Quantity (String), Time (Time), IntOrString (String), and typeless JSON (Value) — all resolve to scalar types at $ref sites without generating Mapper classes.

title: Support additionalProperties in OpenAPI compiler
description: K8s uses additionalProperties heavily for string maps (labels, annotations, ConfigMap data). When a schema has additionalProperties: { type: string } or additionalProperties: true, map it to Shale::Type::Value as a hash passthrough rather than generating a Complex type.
close_reason: additionalProperties-only schemas (no named properties) now resolve to Shale::Type::Value. Schemas with both properties and additionalProperties still generate Complex types normally.

title: Sanitize $ref/$schema property names in OpenAPI code generator
description:
JSONSchemaProps in K8s swagger has properties named $ref and $schema. The OpenAPI code generator preserves these literally, producing `attribute :$ref` which generates `attr_reader :$ref` / `def $ref=(val)` — invalid Ruby syntax since $ is parsed as a global variable prefix.

Discovered in kube_shale: the generated json_schema_props.rb file exists on disk but cannot be required. This blocks runtime introspection of that class and its dependents (5 files total in the CRD chain).

The generator should sanitize property names starting with $ (e.g. $ref → dollar_ref or ref) and add appropriate json/yaml/hsh mappings to preserve the original wire-format key.
close_reason: Strip $ from property names in Utils.snake_case so $ref becomes ref and $schema becomes schema. Original names preserved as mapping keys for wire-format fidelity.

title: Track required fields in OpenAPI compiler
description: OpenAPI schemas have a required array listing mandatory properties. This metadata is not currently captured during compilation. Nice-to-have for K8s support — not a blocker for MVP round-tripping but useful for validation. Could be stored as metadata on Compiler::Property.
close_reason: Added required field tracking to Compiler::Property and threaded required arrays through compile_schema, compile_all_of, and collect_all_of_properties. Backward compatible — required defaults to false.

title: K8s swagger.json support for OpenAPI compiler
description: The K8s 1.29 swagger.json is Swagger 2.0 with 577 definitions. To generate working Shale mappers that round-trip K8s YAML manifests, the compiler needs: yaml mapping blocks, additionalProperties support, special primitive definition handling, dotted-key namespace mapping, and required field tracking. Items 1-4 are blockers; item 5 is nice-to-have.
close_reason: All subtasks complete: yaml mapping blocks, additionalProperties, primitive definitions, dotted-key namespace mapping, and required field tracking.

title: Compile basic OpenAPI schema types into Shale compiler types
description: Map OpenAPI schema type/format combinations to existing Shale Compiler types (String, Integer, Float, Boolean, Date, Time, Value, Complex). Handle nullable (OAS 3.0 style) and type arrays (OAS 3.1 style). Reuse infer_type logic from JSONCompiler adapted for OpenAPI. Tests: each scalar type mapping, nullable handling for both OAS versions, unknown types map to Value.
notes: Recommended model: Haiku — Largely mechanical port of infer_type from JSONCompiler with nullable handling

title: Add yaml do mapping blocks to generated models
description: Currently the OpenAPI compiler only generates json do mapping blocks. K8s manifests are YAML, so generated models need both json do and yaml do blocks in the ERB template output. Modify the MODEL_TEMPLATE or add a parallel template to emit yaml mappings alongside json mappings.
close_reason: OpenAPI compiler now generates both json do and yaml do mapping blocks using its own ERB template.

title: Support dotted-key namespace mapping for K8s definitions
description: K8s definitions use dotted keys like io.k8s.api.core.v1.Pod instead of simple names. The namespace_mapping needs to support transforming these into Ruby module paths (e.g. KubeShale::Core::V1::Pod). May require changes to how schema names are classified and how namespace_mapping keys are matched.
close_reason: Extract last dot-segment as root_name in compile_schema and compile_all_of. Dotted names like io.k8s.api.core.v1.Pod now produce class name Pod instead of mangled Iok8sapicorev1Pod. Full dotted name preserved as id for lookups. namespace_mapping still works with dotted keys.

title: Add OpenAPI format support to shaleb CLI
description: Extend the shaleb CLI to accept -f openapi for compilation. When specified, use Shale::Schema.from_openapi instead of from_json/from_xml. Tests: CLI integration test with -f openapi flag, error handling for invalid OpenAPI input.
notes: Recommended model: Haiku — Trivial, adding one branch to existing CLI
close_reason: Added -f openapi format option to shaleb CLI, delegates to Shale::Schema.from_openapi with the first input file.

title: Resolve OpenAPI $ref paths across the document
description: Implement $ref resolution for OpenAPI-style references (#/components/schemas/Foo for OAS 3.x, #/definitions/Foo for Swagger 2.x). Handle nested refs and circular ref detection. Tests: resolve simple refs, nested refs, cross-schema refs, circular ref error, and ref-not-found error.
notes: Recommended model: Sonnet 4.6 — Algorithmic (nested refs, cycle detection, two path styles) but well-defined problem space
close_reason: Implemented OpenAPIRefResolver with support for OAS 3.x and Swagger 2.0 ref paths, nested resolution, and circular ref detection

title: Extract and parse OpenAPI/Swagger document schemas
description: Load an OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.x document (JSON or YAML), detect the version, and extract the schema definitions from components/schemas (OAS 3.x) or definitions (Swagger 2.x). Ignore all HTTP/routing content. Tests: version detection for OAS 3.0, 3.1, and Swagger 2.0; correct extraction of schemas from each location; error on invalid/missing version.
notes: Recommended model: Sonnet 4.6 — Foundation piece, needs to match existing Shale patterns, straightforward extraction logic
close_reason: Implemented OpenAPIParser with version detection (3.0, 3.1, 2.0) and schema extraction. 14 tests passing, rubocop clean.

title: Add hash do mapping blocks to OpenAPI compiler output
description:
The OpenAPI compiler generates json do and yaml do mapping blocks, but not hash do. This means to_hash outputs snake_case attribute names (e.g. api_version, managed_fields) instead of the original camelCase keys from the schema (apiVersion, managedFields).

For consumers like kube_shale that need API-compatible hashes (e.g. to pass to kubeclient or other K8s API clients), the workaround is JSON.parse(obj.to_json) which is wasteful.

Fix: Add a hash do block to the MODEL_TEMPLATE in openapi_compiler.rb that mirrors the json do mappings. This way to_hash outputs the original schema keys directly.

Example of what generated output should look like:

  json do
    map 'apiVersion', to: :api_version
    map 'kind', to: :kind
  end

  yaml do
    map 'apiVersion', to: :api_version
    map 'kind', to: :kind
  end

  hash do
    map 'apiVersion', to: :api_version
    map 'kind', to: :kind
  end

This is a small template change — just duplicate the json do block as hash do in the ERB template.
close_reason: Added hsh do mapping block to MODEL_TEMPLATE so to_hash preserves original schema keys (e.g. apiVersion) instead of snake_cased attribute names.

title: Generate Shale mapper classes from compiled OpenAPI schemas
description: Wire the OpenAPI compiler output through the existing MODEL_TEMPLATE (or equivalent) to produce Ruby source files with Shale::Mapper subclasses. Add the public API: Shale::Schema.from_openapi(schema, root_name:, namespace_mapping:). Tests: end-to-end compilation of a simple OpenAPI doc to mapper source, multi-schema doc, namespace mapping, root_name override.
notes: Recommended model: Sonnet 4.6 — Integration wiring, needs to precisely match existing JSONCompiler/Schema patterns
close_reason: Implemented OpenAPICompiler with as_models/to_models, wired Shale::Schema.from_openapi facade, full test coverage
